d14a02c847e38a32.summary: The article highlights the limitations of GUI-based API clients as the source of truth for API workflows, advocating for a shift towards using plain text files that reside alongside code. This approach enhances reproducibility, reviewability, and automation in API testing and development.
key_points: API requests should be treated as code artifacts in version control.
Using plain text formats like .http files improves accessibility and collaboration.
The shift from GUI tools to scripts allows for better automation and integration in CI/CD pipelines.
d14a02c847e38a32.takeaway: Transitioning API workflows to plain text files fosters a more reliable and efficient development process.
